top_reviews.title: Comfortable and easy!
top_reviews.text: In the Spring and Summer, I hate having shoes or sandals that you have to strap in, or even velcro.. (I know.. lazy, right? ) These sandals slip on and off easily, but they don't come off when I'm wearing them or rub or anything like that. The little "zip tie" thing works well. They are super comfortable and I'll be wearing them while walking through the creeks and hiking trails.

top_reviews.title: Springy/spongy midsoles, two-tone camo design on PU leather
top_reviews.text:
These are somewhat warmer than my open sandals, which only have three straps counting the heel straps. These cover the top of the foot and have more cover on the sides too, plus the covered toes.

The light gray midsoles are soft, springy, even spongy feeling. It's comfortable, like some sneakers I've tried, but may not wear well, as soft foam tends to compress or wear away.

The outsoles are very grippy, no slipping in these. The tread rubber is moderately hard, so they've got some wear in them.

I usually wear 9.5/10, but I ordered size 12 so I could wear extra socks with these in cold weather. With two thick pairs of winter socks and one regular pair under those, which is what I like during winter, these fit snugly. Because of the toe caps, and maybe the style, they're 5/8" longer than my size-12 open-toed sandals.

They have a two-tone decoration, flat gray on shiny black, on the faux leather (see attached photo). It looks fine close up or in strong light, but in some light it gives these a dusty or worn look.

Golden Camel is a brand from China.

This particular shade and design of gray and black gave them an elegant, decent, and gentlemanly look.
 
The grip is excellent, and they are non-slippery.
 
The materials used are of high quality, the craftsmanship is wonderful, and these would be durable.
 
The upper mesh is breathable, the cushioning is good, and these sandals are very comfortable, even after long walks.
 
I am very happy with this purchase, and they are worth every penny.

top_reviews.title: Comfortable and easy!
top_reviews.text: In the Spring and Summer, I hate having shoes or sandals that you have to strap in, or even velcro.. (I know.. lazy, right? ) These sandals slip on and off easily, but they don't come off when I'm wearing them or rub or anything like that. The little "zip tie" thing works well. They are super comfortable and I'll be wearing them while walking through the creeks and hiking trails.

top_reviews.title: Springy/spongy midsoles, two-tone camo design on PU leather
top_reviews.text:
These are somewhat warmer than my open sandals, which only have three straps counting the heel straps. These cover the top of the foot and have more cover on the sides too, plus the covered toes.

The light gray midsoles are soft, springy, even spongy feeling. It's comfortable, like some sneakers I've tried, but may not wear well, as soft foam tends to compress or wear away.

The outsoles are very grippy, no slipping in these. The tread rubber is moderately hard, so they've got some wear in them.

I usually wear 9.5/10, but I ordered size 12 so I could wear extra socks with these in cold weather. With two thick pairs of winter socks and one regular pair under those, which is what I like during winter, these fit snugly. Because of the toe caps, and maybe the style, they're 5/8" longer than my size-12 open-toed sandals.

They have a two-tone decoration, flat gray on shiny black, on the faux leather (see attached photo). It looks fine close up or in strong light, but in some light it gives these a dusty or worn look.

Golden Camel is a brand from China.
